composite_controller_specific_configs._comment_backend: sim2real_backend and sim2real_policy_config are set at runtime by collect_demos_sim2real.py (--sim2real-backend / --sim2real-policy-config). This one config file covers every non-sonic sim2real policy family (heft, scalebfm, bfm_zero, ...): they all drive full-body GMR-retargeted PICO motion via a gmr_subprocess.GMRSubprocess, consumed over ZMQ by sim2real's own unmodified RealtimeMotionBuffer -- see robocasa/g1_host/bridge.py module docstring.
composite_controller_specific_configs._comment_mode: Three-state PICO UX (no kPlanner, no VR-3pt, so ModeManager runs the 'tracking' chord profile and B+Y / L-stick are muted): A+B+X+Y engages into IDLE, A+X toggles POSE. POSE tracks your body; IDLE holds whatever pose POSE left off in, motionless; A+B+X+Y ramps back to the standing default and holds there. IDLE and the stop ramp are not recorded.
composite_controller_specific_configs._comment_blend: sim2real_pose_blend_s: seconds to ramp from the held pose onto the live stream when entering POSE (and back to standing on the stop chord), so re-entry never snaps -- see g1_bridge/reference_blend.py. 0 disables the ramp. Do not go far below 1.0 on hardware: the shorter the ramp, the higher the reference angular velocity when the held and live poses differ a lot.
composite_controller_specific_configs._comment_record_idle: sim2real_record_idle: record IDLE / stop-ramp frames too. Off by default -- those frames have no operator command behind them, so they would land in a dataset as if the robot had been told to stand still.
composite_controller_specific_configs._comment_pico: pico_source: 'real' on Ubuntu with XRoboToolkit, 'mock' for headless/plumbing self-checks.
